enable_compiled_autograd: enable compiled autograd with a compiler function to trace and compile autograd graphs
disable_compiled_autograd: disable compiled autograd and restore the prior autograd compiler
create_AutogradCompilerInstance: create an AutogradCompilerInstance with a compiler function to capture and compile autograd FX graphs
begin_capture_AutogradCompilerInstance: begin capture on AutogradCompilerInstance to trace tensor inputs and sizes into an FX graph
maybe_clone_tensor: clone a tensor while preserving strides, returning None if input is None
